name: Villamontán de la Valduerna (Spain)
description: Green field with a triangle with its base along the hoist bearing the crowned municipal arms of Villamontán de la Valduerna, the fly of red and green stripes edged yellow with a white triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Villamontán de la Valduerna; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: red and green stripes edged yellow at the fly
edges of the stripes and crown of the arms
white triangle in the fly with its base towards the hoist
Villamontán de la Valduerna arms — tree, chalice and flags on white
